definitions.explanation: To make smooth and shiny by rubbing.
To clean teeth with a toothbrush.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}をきれいに{磨|みが}いた。
examples.english: I polished the floor until it was clean.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}をピカピカに{磨|みが}いた。
examples.english: I polished the mirror until it was sparkling.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{歯|は}を{磨|みが}く。
examples.english: I brush my teeth every morning.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べた{後|あと}は{歯|は}を{磨|みが}いたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should brush your teeth after eating.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}して{腕|うで}を{磨|みが}いている。
examples.english: I'm practicing every day to improve my skills.

notes:
{磨|みが}く is a godan verb meaning to polish, brush, or refine.

CONJUGATION:
- {磨|みが}かない (negative)
- {磨|みが}きます (polite)
- {磨|みが}いて (te-form)
- {磨|みが}いた (past)

LITERAL USES (physical polishing):
- {歯|は}を{磨|みが}く: to brush teeth
- {靴|くつ}を{磨|みが}く: to polish shoes
- {床|ゆか}を{磨|みが}く: to polish the floor
- {鏡|かがみ}を{磨|みが}く: to polish a mirror

FIGURATIVE USES (improvement):
- {腕|うで}を{磨|みが}く: to hone one's skills
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}を{磨|みが}く: to refine technique
- {感性|かんせい}を{磨|みが}く: to cultivate sensibility
- {才能|さいのう}を{磨|みが}く: to polish one's talent

RELATED WORDS:
- {歯|は}{磨|みが}き: toothpaste, tooth brushing
- {歯|は}ブラシ: toothbrush
- {靴|くつ}{磨|みが}き: shoe polishing, shoeshine
